restoration_note: Teaching describes the eye as microcosm: four visible 'likenesses' (ⲡⲉⲓⲛⲉ) and a hidden fifth, doubled into outer/inner fourfolds (the senses' visible operation vs. their hidden ground), with fire/darkness concealed inside and the Living Air (Divine Truth as perceiving Spirit) discriminating; the riddle of pupil-by-day/blind-by-night signifies the gate between upper and lower place through which the First Man descends into the four climes. Editor restorations cluster at line-edges and are firmly constrained by standard formulas (ⲡⲉⲓⲛⲉ→ⲛⲉⲓⲛⲉ; ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲛ; ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ; ⲓ̈ⲱⲣⲍ̄; ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ ⲛⲣⲱⲙⲉ) and were accepted. The middle of the chapter (sections 5196–5204) is too fragmentary — long lacunae (12, 15, 21 chars) without adequate trace or formula constraint were left unrestored rather than invented. One conjectural fill (ⲡⲣⲱⲙⲉ at {23}) is offered at low confidence based on the First Man theme and the 'ⲙⲉ' trace.
